products.name: Vellum
products.note: Personal AI assistant; on-device Mac app or cloud; cross-app memory; privacy-first design

profile_text.body:
Vellum describes itself as a personal AI assistant designed to know the user deeply, evolve over time, and remain exclusively theirs. The product runs either as an on-device Mac app or in the cloud, and emphasizes a privacy-first design with cross-app memory intended to reflect the way a user naturally remembers things. Users can configure the assistant's personality and supply personal context to shape its behavior away from what the company characterizes as generic AI responses.

Vellum is free to start, with credits provided at sign-up, and the company states it passes model provider costs through at cost with no markup. Additional use is available through pre-paid credits, and paid plans begin at $30 per month, which adds a larger machine, more storage, and bundled credits. No litigation, regulatory filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
